paite: Misiangthoute a dia thilpiak thu zaw na kiang uah ka gelh akiphamoh kei hi.
heading: Misiangthoute A Dia Thilpiak

paite: Na kimandan uh ka thei ngal a, huai lam thu ah zaw nikum in Akhaia gamte kimansa in a-omta uh chi in Masidonia gam a mite kiang ah ka hon na suang zel a; na phattuamngaihna un alak ua mi tampi atok halhta hi.
Himahleh huai lam thu ah zaw ka hon suanna bangmah lou ahong hihlouhna ding in unaute ka hohsak zel hi; ka gen bangtak a mansa a na na omtheihna ding un.
Huchi lou in zaw Masidonia gam a mi kuate hiam in ahon zuih zenzen uleh, kiman lou in hong mu le uh, noute kia hilou in noute ka hon ginna uh lam ah kou leng ka zahlak kha ding uhi.

Huaiziak in unaute bel nou kiang a hong masa a, hoihtak a thilpiak na chiamkholhte uh na bawlkhol ding a, nget kiphamoh in ka gingta hi, laksak teitei bang hilou a phaltak a piak bang zaw a mansa a na omna ding un.
Himahleh huai lam thu ah zaw, theh tawm in a-at tawm ding a, theh tam in a-at tam ding hi.
heading: Tuh Bangbang At Chiat Ding

paite: Michih in it pipi a pe lou in, piak louh theih louh a ngaihtuah a pe tuan lou in, alungtang ua atup bang zel un pe chiat uhen; Pathian in kipaktak a pe mite ahi a-it.
Huan Pathian in hehpihna chiteng in na tung uah avuk thei ahi; huchi in nou bangkim ah ahun ngial nei gige in, nasep hoih chiteng a ding in na hau thei ding uhi;
"Ahawmzak a; gentheite kiang ah apia a; adiktatna tangtawn in a-om gige," chih gelh bang in.
Thehpa kiang a achi pepa leh nek ding a tanghou pepa'n na theh ding uh chi ahon pe ding a, ahon hihpungsak ding a, na diktatna gahte uh leng ahon hihpungsak ding.
Thilphalna chiteng koute ziak a Pathian kiang a kipahthu genna pen nei ding a, bangkim a hihhauh a om in,
hiai sepsakna nna in misiangthoute taksapna awngte ahuksak kia ahi kei a, Pathian kiang a kipahthu genna tampi in leng aluanglet lai ahi.
Hiai nasepna a etkhiak a om in Khrist tanchinhoih lam a na thugin uh na zuihdan uleh amau a ding leh mi tengteng a dia thilpiak a na thilphaldan un Pathian na hih thupi ding uh ahi.
Amau ngei in leng na tung ua Pathian hehpihna thupi mahmah ziak in, nou a dia thumsak kawm in ahon ngai mahmah uhi.
Athilpiak gen zoh vual louh ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
